title: A Debt for the Ghost
author: Jonah Nystrom
blurb: Mara Marchetti, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
